gs.subtitle: Add the marketplace as a source once, then install individual plugins. Every command can be copied.
gs.step1Desc: Inside Claude Code, register this repository as a plugin source.
gs.step1CliDesc: Or from a terminal, scoped to the current project:
gs.step2Desc: Pick a plugin from the catalog and install it. Dependencies are resolved automatically.
gs.step3Desc: Refresh the marketplace listing first, then update the installed plugin.
gs.step4Desc: Pick up new or updated plugins in a running session without restarting.
gs.step5Title: Roll back via the stable channel
gs.step5Desc: There is no plugin rollback command. Rolling back switches the project to the stable channel, where every plugin is pinned to a released tag: add the stable marketplace, refresh it, disable the plugin from the latest channel, install it from stable, then reload.
gs.noteText: The first refreshes the list of sources (where plugins come from); the second updates the code of one installed plugin.
